newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil plane with Carnival queen falls into sea.
newsitem.headline: Brazil plane with Carnival queen falls into sea.

text.p: A small aircraft carrying one of Brazil's best-known carnival beauties fell into the sea off the end of a runway at Rio de Janeiro's domestic Santos Dumont Airport on Thursday, officials said.
All five passengers and crew of the Cessna 550 were rescued, an airport spokeswoman said.
One of the passengers was Valeria Valenca, who for the past four years has been Globo television station's carnival queen, a Globo official said.

The 25-year-old model is known throughout Brazil as "Globeleza", the samba-dancing beauty whose naked body, glistening with bodypaint, sets the mood before the station's coverage of the annual carnival.
Also on board was Valenca's husband, Hans Donner, who is Globo's artistic director, the Globo official said.
None of the passengers or crew was injured, he added.
The airplane failed to take off and fell into the sea 164 feet (50 metres) from the end of the runway, the airport spokeswoman said.
She said rescue workers were trying to recover the plane, which belonged to an air taxi company. It was not yet known why the plane failed to take off.
